property_summary: For any caller and any target address passed before Initialized is called, the reference C accepts SetLogFile(target) (the call returns) and the public Log getter equals the target; the mutant always reverts from SetLogFile so there exist fuzzed inputs where the call fails (reverts) and Log is not set, violating that rule.
change_summary: Replaced the body to revert unconditionally (making the call always fail and thus Log unchanged), differing from original which can set Log.
